newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow on Tuesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not well established, few sales steady. Inquiry moderate, demand fair.

Sales confirmed on 2,300 slaughter steers and 1,800 slaughter heifers Tuesday. For the week to date 10,800 head confirmed including 5,600 of previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.

Slauughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1175 lbs 66.00. Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1050 lbs 66.00; few mixed Commercial to Choice 1150-1200 lb heifers and heiferettes 65.00.
confirmed - 4,100 last week - 75,100 last year - none
